source.title: First-Dollar Mission: qualify and complete the first paid AI-assisted repair
source.body:
## Objective
Get BountyForge's **first legitimately paid AI-assisted coding repair**, then repeat toward a **$2,000/month gross** target. This is a private income-generation operator, **not a SaaS to sell**. Optimize for accepted work and net receipts, not developmental test counts.

## Constraints
- $0 additional spending; no paid APIs, runners, infrastructure, application credits, or subscriptions.
- Never use the owner's Mac; don't interfere with Phase 15 or either existing draft PR.
- No Reddit and no phone-dependent outreach.
- Do not accept third-party code, tokens, personal information or customer credentials into the public runner or current unadmitted sandbox.
- Do not submit bids, send messages, claim bounties, accept terms, deliver external work, enable scheduled inference, collect money, or promise results without the owner's explicit approval.
- Respect venue rules on automation and AI use, US eligibility, funding, and payout/KYC. A posting is not an offer or escrow.

## Live research checkpoint, 2026-10-23
1. **Upwork candidate A (research only): $70 fixed**: [Improve existing Python AI document-extraction tool](https://www.upwork.com/freelance-jobs/apply/Python-Developer-Improve-Existing-Document-Extraction-Tool_~022111905971757282297/). Published Oct 18; PDF→JSON extraction, missed fields/layout differences and inconsistent structure. Potentially bounded if sample PDFs, expected outputs and tests are supplied. Current bidding availability, client reliability, AI-use permission and external execution safety **unverified**. Public page direct fetch blocked with 403.
2. **Upwork candidate B (research only): $200 fixed**: [Flask + Airtable authentication fix](https://www.upwork.com/freelance-jobs/apply/Python-Flask-Airtable-Developer-Needed-Urgent-Authentication-Fix_~022104776202067289136/). Published Sep 29; login/signup, Airtable lookups, session/auth. Requires private code/credential-safe test harness; current bidding availability, AI permission and source custody **unverified**. Public page direct fetch blocked with 403.
3. **Reject**: [tscircuit/dsn-converter#54](https://github.com/tscircuit/dsn-converter/issues/54). Algora shows several nominal open bounty amounts, but original issue was **closed** when checked Oct 23.
4. **Reject**: [tscircuit/jlcsearch#92](https://github.com/tscircuit/jlcsearch/issues/92). Algora still lists it, but original issue was **closed** when checked Oct 23.
5. **Reject for now**: [tenstorrent/tt-metal#59732](https://github.com/tenstorrent/tt-metal/issues/59732). $3,000 and open but **assigned** and requires Wormhole/Blackhole hardware acceptance; out of scope.
6. **Reject for now**: [PG-AGI/toingg-jarvis#13](https://github.com/PG-AGI/toingg-jarvis/issues/13). Open/$5 label, but multi-OS installer pipeline, unknown financial backing, low return and substantial scope.

## Marketplace and bounty payment cautions verified Oct 23
- [Upwork Help: Connects](https://support.upwork.com/hc/en-us/articles/211062898-Understanding-and-using-Connects): applications may consume Connects and purchases cost money. Do not buy any. Use only existing/free credits if platform terms and account permit; available balance and listing-specific required Connects remain unknown.
- [Opire official payments](https://docs.opire.dev/rewards/pricing): claiming/creating a bounty **does not cause automatic payment**. The bounty creator separately reviews and arranges payment. Reject any repository claiming guaranteed automated Opire payout until independently substantiated; for example, claude-builders-bounty/claude-builders-bounty#4 currently states automatic payout on merge in conflict with Opire's own policy.
- Existing owner-only [Hatchable BountyForge dashboard](https://leftsock-bountyforge.hatchable.site) read-only status on Oct 23: 25 discovered candidates, zero verified funded and zero third-party repair attempts; the discoverer is not commercial admission.

## Next actual actions
- Check whether A and B still accept proposals in the owner's authorized platform account, whether application requires paid Connects, whether AI-assisted work is permitted and whether the client accepts an explicitly bounded paid milestone. **Do not spend to apply.**
- Prioritize the smallest objectively testable slice with expected results and permitted, non-sensitive code. If neither passes, search for another verified lead; do not manufacture 'actionable' from an advertisement.
- Prepare **owner-reviewed** concise proposal and privacy-safe contract scope *after* availability/cost/permission verification. No external contact automatically.
- Keep active Codex repair engine as available-session helper; Qwen repair accuracy remains unproven, so don't commit to unattended delivery.
- Define a controlled, lawful and private source-custody path before inspecting paid customer code. No transfer of private source to public Actions or unapproved model providers.
- Execute only after authorization; collect targeted test results, independent verifier evidence, owner sign-off, customer acceptance and a confirmed payout. Record actual provider/platform fees; never classify a paid listing as earned revenue.

## Definition of done
- First paid job accepted, delivered under approved terms and **payout confirmed**.
- Complete ledger: source URL, eligibility/AI policy, platform fees, contract amount, work/time/model cost, independent tests, acceptance, gross receipt and net receipt.
- If no task passes, publish a specific **blocked** verdict with evidence, not a synthetic success.
